ns2:section.sectionText: Students learn the social and economic effects of new and emerging communication tools on the agriculture sectors of society (theories & models), and the basic skills required to implement these new media (practice). Agriculture includes a variety of sectors such as food, natural resources, animals, biofuels, and human health/nutrition. Course is taught through the frameworks of public relations, agricultural communications, and information diffusion.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Agricultural Communications major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Not intended for Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
